title: PDF LAB Workbench Batch B: narrow real authoring of a second reading
statement: Adds in-place authoring to the workbench: a typed port of poems.js bend(), held byte-identical to the legacy writer and to lab.py poem by tests, builds a real variant in the browser from a hash-checked parent, shows lineage and object diff, labels the result not measured, and exports/imports versioned recipes (also lab.py poem JSON). Legacy files unchanged. Proposed for review.
conditions: Visitor-made files are not rendered or extracted by the workbench; an independent manual pdftotext/MuPDF check of one variant is recorded in BATCH-B.md only.
Narrow writer limits unchanged: four printable-ASCII lines of 1-32 characters on the A01 fixture.
Checks run locally: typecheck, 21 tests, build, 11-check production smoke, browser walkthrough at 1440/768/390.
